issue: The reproduction does not match the PRD's suspected defect. Before the fix an over-cap directory could not carry a valid saved skip/machine entry, because load_ledgers rejected entries without sha256. So "a saved verdict resurfaces repeatedly" was unreachable as the PRD worded it. The test works around this by recording a sha256 while the directory was small and then growing it. That makes the confirmation indirect: the real defect was "cannot record a verdict", not "recorded verdict resurfaces". The PRD's premise was only partly confirmed, and this is not stated anywhere.
